suite: Retired single-name global Pause capture: native wheel regression

checks.name: Exact build starts with the user Classic/Feyz layout and generated personal input
Native Next retires a captured paused personal single; native Start/Pause/Resume/Finish all remain usable
Native local Finish directly after global Pause retires only the old sole single capture
Every served application byte matches disk with no missing assets or JS/SRI faults

limitations: Exact Classic/Feyz application scripts, normal visual CSS, and genuine Chromium native media clocks at 384×691. Generated six-second tones occupy three isolated personal recording slots; no user recordings, images, browser profile or health report is read.

All wheel inputs are native trusted pointer clicks after measured hit-target placement. Only the global Pause is invoked through the production registry API to represent a media-session Pause. No direct-navigation fallback or synthetic completion event is used.

The engineering fixture controls device TTS, which is forbidden for these personal recording scenarios. Service workers are blocked; physical Android screen locking, speaker audibility, OS audio focus and SW activation are not measured.
The separate Node command-scope suite verifies independently paused background providers. This browser run focuses on the sole single-name captured mix that previously stranded the wheel controls.
